title: 方位介词 next to / behind / on the left of
unitTitle: Module 3 My school 我的学校

questions.knowledge_point: 方位介词 next to / behind / on the left of
questions.question: 「图书馆在操场左边。」的英文是（　）
options: The library is on the left of the playground.
The library is in the left of the playground.
The library is on the left playground.
The library is at the left of playground.
questions.answer: The library is on the left of the playground.

knowledge.point: 方位介词 next to / behind / on the left of
knowledge.core_concept: next to 在……旁边、behind 在……后面、on the left of 在……左边、in front of 在……前面。
knowledge.key_formula: The library is on the left of the playground.
common_mistakes: on the left 漏掉 of。
knowledge.tips: left/right 后接 of 再接对象。
